the epitopes of two MAbs reacting with human IL-2 have been determined using a phage displayed-peptides library.
two monoclonal antibody (MAbs) recognizing human interleukin 2 (hIL-2), CB-IL2. 1 and CB-IL2, 2, were characterized using phage displayed peptide libraries.
we have characterized two monoclonal antibody binding to human interleukin 2, using phage display peptide libraries.

the development of an efficient method for the identification of epitopes on IL-2.
the characterization of the antigenic epitopes of the human IL-2 molecule, and the development of a sensitive ELISA method for the measurement of IL-2 in biological fluids.
the characterization of epitopes on IL-2 using phages display technology.

the phage-displayed-peptide library technology is an extremely powerful tool for epitope mapping.
